title: Unit Event — The First Concerto

meta.Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD each contend with the missions Ken has assigned them, with their sights on the day they surpass RAD WEEKEND. Toya's task is to write every track they're going to use for their event, and he attempts to pour everything into a song, but that's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, this doesn't sound right either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This song won't be able to reproduce the atmosphere from that night.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Find a way to give it more energy.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Find a way to write a song that can help us surpass RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even if you do get better, just putting on events like you've been doing until now probably won't get you far.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's hard to make a flame burn bright when it's close to going out. You won't get many chances.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why... You're going to split up the work.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: These will be crucial steps towards putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, Akito, you go reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I see...
We're each going to do what's necessary for us to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito's being tasked with reigniting our audience. That suits him very well, so I'm sure he'll succeed...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You're going to be the “track maker”.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll be solely responsible for all the tracks your team is going to use to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm...going to make all of them...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Obviously, a good event needs good songs. On top of that, you're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, which means they need to be of a certain quality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, Toya is really good at this stuff...
But making him do everything on his own doesn't seem fair...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Then, I'll take this opportunity to explain my reasoning.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, let me talk about the songs we made for RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The three of us made them together by putting everything we felt and experienced into them.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's right.
Especially because it was the last event Nagi could sing in.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We made sure not to leave anything behind.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And it was worth it in the end because we'd never performed at that kind of level before...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, you'll need to come up with songs that can surpass that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Songs that encompass everything you've felt and experienced.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Without anything like that, it won't matter how well you perform. You won't be able to surpass the atmosphere we created that night. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The atmosphere from that night wasn't born from Ken or the others' singing. Those songs moved everyone's hearts. It was clear even from that video...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I really up to the task...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe we have plenty of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially after making the decision to carry everyone's dreams forward. Yours, Nagi's Taiga's and all the locals...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I doubt our resolve falls short of you and your team's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, me coming up with songs that can reflect that is a different story...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I had a chance to listen to what you've all already made...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And there's something different about your songs, Toya. A lot of them didn't require lyrics. I could feel what was going on through sound alone...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I think you've had a special connection to music since you were a child. A connection that most people don't have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Those experiences are what I believe will help you create...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Think about what the composer was thinking and feeling. Think about why they wrote this song the way they did.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Of course, Toya, you're not the only one who can weave their feelings and emotions into their songs.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And I know those feelings are very complicated. Still, I think you have the best shot at turning what your team is feeling into music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. I did feel a lot of different emotions when I listened to your song, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too. As sad as I am to hear that our old songs won't really do...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think you'll do a great job of making songs that reflect how we really feel, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Still, I know I'm asking a lot of you...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And it'll certainly be tough, but do you think you can handle it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you believe that I'm going to surpass the songs that you and your team made, Ken... Then I'm up for the challenge...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Looks like we're both about to have it rough.
But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think that sums up what I've been feeling until now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I honestly had no idea, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Unfortunately, my dream of having you guys meet Aunt Nagi never came true...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But now, I wanna sing with you guys and do everything we can to make sure she hears us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiraishi. I have a much better understanding of your thoughts and feelings now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
Make sure the songs you write really reflect that, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
They will.
Lastly, Azusawa, would you mind telling me about your feelings?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You've been talking for a while now.
Would you like me to refill these?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you for asking.
We're sorry for staying this long.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
It's nice to see you all working so hard.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
MEIKO, we're here!
Which ice cream did you pick as the flavor of the day...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey, you're all here today!
Your timing couldn't have been better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh?
What's this notebook for? It looks like you have a lot written down on it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
You were put in charge of making all the songs, Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'm honestly still not sure about this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I decided to do what I can to accomplish this task. Starting with asking the others about their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. He's been asking them about the things they've thought and felt up to this point, and is going to work those into his songs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I see! That sounds like a good plan, Toya!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While we're at it, would you mind if I took a peek at your notebook...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess you seeing it wouldn't be much of a problem...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Is this a timeline of events?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I thought this was the best way of illustrating everything the others have felt until now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What made them decide to start singing... What they've felt and been doing since experiencing or learning about RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having all those things laid out in an orderly manner has helped me make a few discoveries.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
For Akito, it says...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
“Started singing during junior high school.
Referred to videos online to practice...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you didn't have to go into so much detail.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I thought these details would help me later on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, true...
And you take everything you do pretty seriously.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I was told that I'd have to take all of your feelings and turn them into songs, I began wondering if I'd do any of you justice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because expressing someone else's feelings as if they're my own sounds incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I felt the need to ask you all directly and put pen to paper like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You put that much thought into this talk...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I think you're going to do just fine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You said you weren't sure just before, but I don't think you have any reason to worry at all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because you're already doing everything you can to do your teammates' feelings justice!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, ask me any questions you have about songwriting! I'll be more than happy to advise you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I greatly appreciate your offer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to what we were talking about... Azusawa, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! But I don't have as much to say about music compared to An and Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Again, some things you have felt may seem insignificant, but they're a part of who you are right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, please tell me everything you can.
What have you felt up to this point?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks!
Then, I'll start with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The shock and awe they felt after witnessing RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The pure exhilaration they felt. Vowing to surpass that legendary night. Struggling to succeed. Doubting oneself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Picking up music. The joy and apprehension of stepping into a new world...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Deciding to surpass that dream, and go beyond it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Okay...
I think I know how I'm going to turn all of these feelings into music now. Next is to actually start making it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma taught me quite a lot, but I still don't know much about writing my own songs...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I'll just have to learn as I go.
But I'm going to be pressed for time because of practice and all...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh...
I can learn more by...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think that's all the books Dad has on this subject. I'll need to put them back in his study once I've finished reading through them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Street and classical music are created in very different ways...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But these should still help.
After all, my knowledge of classical music has helped greatly when writing songs.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Anyway, I'll read these in my room.
Which may take all night...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This part needs to have more presence...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's supposed to be a reflection of what we felt when we first saw or learned about RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Phew...
I managed to put together one song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, let's try hearing it from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's not bad...
I've captured the feelings I was hoping to.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it's still missing a few things...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All of the songs in RAD WEEKEND made us so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(We all felt a fire light up inside of us...
I remember that vividly.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But this song doesn't cause any of that to happen.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It lacks depth...
Nothing about it makes my heart race.
It's incomplete in that sense.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After getting help from Soma with composing, I thought I'd come to understand how to imbue music with powerful feelings to create a powerful sound...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But where do I go from here...?
I could try to fix what I already have...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't bother...
This song won't help surpass RAD WEEKEND anyway.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've made songs using a few different approaches since then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But none feel right.
They're all missing that spark.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I really up to this task...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If my first song is going this poorly, then what does it mean for the rest?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ken believes that I can do this.
So, I need to figure out what's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(He's coming home later than usual...
No, he said he has a performance at a concert hall coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means he must be very busy preparing for it. He even said that he'd be playing some of his own songs, so he may've been working on...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What would he think of my song...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's both a professional musician and composer. There's a chance that he may be able to point out the issues with this song—)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad still doesn't really approve of street music. He may not even be willing to listen to it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, given its quality, I'm not sure if he should hear it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
I should still ask despite the odds.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, I know you just got home, but do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Fine, but make it quick...
I have a busy day tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like for you to listen to this song I wrote.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's for an event that—

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Why are you even asking? You chose to not take the same path as me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd say that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I still want you to listen to it.
As a creator, I'd like to hear what you have to say about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right now, I...
We're getting ready to put on an incredibly important event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
An event that means everything to us.
If it doesn't go well, our dream may never come true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I've been asked to come up with the songs for it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I need to produce some good ones no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, please!
Tell me what you think! Anything will do!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's the one you've been playing on your speakers, no? You could hear it throughout the whole house. Did you think I wouldn't notice?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He probably thinks I'm pathetic to ask for his advice after turning my back on his tutelage...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Perhaps...
My lack of confidence was at the forefront and this song has just become an expression of that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time to be feeling down.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep looking for a way to produce that energy and atmosphere...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're having trouble achieving that same energy...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Through trial and error, I tried to find the best way to work in our feelings while trying to achieve that energy. But nothing has worked so far...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I think it's a really good song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, I feel like it's missing quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want this song to be an expression of our resolve, so it needs to feel powerful...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, what if you built things up more before the chorus by adding another part or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Raising the tempo during the first verse could also help give the beginning of the song more momentum.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your song has gotten better each time, so the listener should be able to understand what you're trying to achieve...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you may be right about it not having the same energy as what you heard during RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means... It may be necessary to further analyze the songs that were played during RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I can break them down and learn why Ken and his team's songs are so compelling, then I might be able to find the key to making my song better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I'll help you with that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh? You will...?
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Starting over and going with a different sort of sound didn't help either...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I've tried everything I could think of...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
What were you just saying?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing. We were just shooting the breeze, but you didn't seem very engaged in our conversation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I apologize for not paying attention.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's fine.
We all have a lot on our plate right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, I'm also pretty stuck...
I don't know what I'm supposed to do next.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we've gotta find a way to succeed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We have to keep moving forward.
Am I right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've tried looking at why my song isn't able to achieve that energy from multiple different angles...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've changed the tempo and adjusted the notes many times. I've tried using different sound sources because I thought it was a quality issue. I even began learning about how non-classical music is composed.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Wait.. Was I too hasty trying to apply that knowledge...? But KAITO didn't think I was doing anything wrong technically...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm responsible for expressing how we all feel...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But I'm failing to do so.
Why is that?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm wandering around in the dark while grasping at straws...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm going to fail at my task of writing this team's songs.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I can't live up to you and everyone's expectations, Dad...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I can't let that happen...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not going to let them down!
I'm going to succeed...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still don't know what I'm doing wrong, but I just have to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Anything I can think of...!
Anything that I haven't tried yet...!!)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
For your coffee? Sure.
Just give me one second.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Toya...?
He got up very early and took his breakfast into his room...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: He's having breakfast in his room? Where are his manners?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
But he's been working very hard on this song of his lately. I'm actually a little worried.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I asked him if he'd like to sit and relax while having some breakfast with us, but he said he doesn't have time...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Toya, don't tell me you haven't slept...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I did...
I won't be able to perform very well if I don't...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, do we have any bottles of mineral water left? I'd rather not waste time coming down for a drink each time.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, we do...
But are you sure about all this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
I apologize for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I have to do this... I have to...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Is he really going to be okay...?
(Otherwise, you'll be seen as a failure.)

(Mom... Dad...
Everyone has such high hopes for me...)
(How long do I have to keep doing this?)
(When am I going to satisfy their expectations?)
Is this really it for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like that's all I've been seeing lately...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I keep getting thrown back to that time. All these wounds are opening back up...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time to be dealing with those things right now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I have to keep working...
I have to complete at least one song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I was worried that you haven't been getting enough sleep since you've been staying up so late recently.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I know what you're working on means quite a lot to you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: But it'd be all for naught if it took a heavy toll on your health. Why don't you take a little break...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Then, I'll try going for a walk.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
You will...?
Please be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel terrible about making her worry so much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But I don't have a second to spare.
I need to keep working on this song.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, if I can't work at home, then I should go to...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I'll continue working at MEIKO's place.
I may even be able to ask KAITO for help if he's there.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This isn't good...
I feel dizzy and sleep-deprived...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I don't have time to rest...
Not now. Not here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Why are you squatted down like that?
Are you by chance not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, this is nothing...
I just need to take a short break and...
*Wince*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No.
I can't just let you wallow in pain.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sit tight.
I'll go get you a drink from the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I feel much better after having some of your tea and snacks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Looks like you were just sleep-deprived.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're feeling better, then you should go back and get some real rest. Please stop by after you've had a chance to recover.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I will.
Again, I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I don't feel great about how you've been pushing yourself so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is your song giving you that much trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Every time I feel like I've got it right, I realize that I'm still nowhere near achieving the energy Ken and his team produced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And no matter how much I think about it, I can't figure out why...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, what if you went back to square one?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
Back to the moment when you started working on this song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember how you took down notes about the others' feelings?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
I have it right here actually.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't you take another look at it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe it's best to go back to where you started when you can't find the answer to a question.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Lately, all I've been thinking about is why I haven't been able to achieve that same energy. I just kept looking for whatever it was that I was missing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But going back to the beginning may allow me to see it with a fresh pair of eyes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll try doing that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, Toya, would you mind if I had a look at your notes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You showed them to KAITO already, right?
I'm actually a little curious myself as to what you wrote...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'm sure the others would also be okay with it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, when you all performed in STAY GOLDEN that second time, Kohane decided to believe in herself because An believed in her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that was what stood out to her the most. And I'd like to weave what she felt that time into my song...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to hearing what that sounds like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Still, this notebook...
It's really full of everyone's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I was under the impression that these notes would help me come up with a good song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But things just aren't going that way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your notes went into great detail regarding how Kohane, An and Akito feel.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there were only a few tidbits about you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I already know how I feel, so I don't think I need to spell it all out in words...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Your feelings are also going to play a major role in your song, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what if you do for yourself what you did for the others? Try writing down everything that you've felt until now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really?
Are you sure you're feeling better...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I do feel better.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whenever I think about my feelings, I'm reminded of quite a lot of other things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
Things that I'm not entirely proud of...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't you try reflecting on those things...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't seem like you want to talk about whatever this subject matter is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if that's what's keeping you from completing your song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
If I'm going to incorporate the others' feelings, then I'll need to take a closer look at my own as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll try doing that today after I get back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But please try to get some rest first.
I wouldn't want you to start feeling dizzy again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I will.
And thank you for the concern.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't seem like you want to talk about whatever this subject matter is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if that's what's keeping you from completing your song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Think about everything that I've experienced until now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I started playing the piano when I was three.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't have many clear memories from back then, but I do remember the sounds I heard...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I could only play simple notes using the keys, but Dad just gently pressed down on one and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't think I'm ever going to forget what I heard for as long as I live. It was such a beautiful sound. Like a gentle breeze causing light to poke through the leaves of a tree...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It was such a strange sensation...
We were playing the same piano, but producing such different sounds.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So strange that I wanted to keep playing it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wanted to learn how to do what Dad did.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That was how I first began playing music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was also the beginning of some very difficult times...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
No, again.
Don't think you're going to bed before you get it right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I knew that since I'd already seen the way his practices with my brothers went.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I wasn't expecting him to be that hard on me. Even now, whenever I find myself in front of a piano, that anxiety comes rushing back.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But you shouldn't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: The world of music is vast and endless. It's much bigger than you realize.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But you may someday come to understand why that is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not only was that the first time he ever praised me, but he said I have a chance to understand the truth someday.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I wanted to meet his expectations.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But as time went on, my fingers started feeling heavier and heavier.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Endless practices day after day.
The immense pressure of having to perform well during contests. And...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I practice every single day in the same room. I'm not allowed to do anything else...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I know you have high expectations of me, Dad. I know why you're asking so much of me.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Is this really it for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You're going to throw away everything you've worked for just like that?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line:
What...?
What do you know about me?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: It's my life! I want to live it the way I want!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line:
I want to do what other people do!
I want to experience as many new things as I can! That's all...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I'm sick of being stuck in this room...!!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I ran and dashed all of Dad's hopes for me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Some have told me that it doesn't count as running...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I thought I would see classical music through a positive lens by now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the pain I felt back then keeps me from doing so...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it causing me to think, “I can't”...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I ran and tossed aside something that meant everything to me... I've given up once already, so there's no reason I'd ever be able to match Ken and his team's resolve...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Have I been feeling that subconsciously...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That would give Dad's words so much more meaning...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I... I've been viewing myself as someone who ran away. Someone who lacks pride....)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm struggling to write a good song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's why I can't commit to it like Ken and his team did with theirs...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I still have to do this...!
I have to make these songs so that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND together!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I can't just get rid of these feelings that are weighing me down...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why did I decide to run away that day...?!

What's going on?
Why are you shouting?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Keep your door closed.
Your voice carried throughout the house.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Your room's a mess...
Why don't you clean up a little?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He hasn't been here since I stopped playing classical music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is my chance to ask him.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please let me ask you again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tell me what you think of my song.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Oh? Does that mean it's a little more tolerable now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I'm still doing a lot of trial and error...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Sounds like you're still wasting time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I haven't been wasting my time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've been trying any and all of the solutions that I could come up with. Now, I think I'm actually close to finding the answer...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Then, you should be focusing all of your attention on that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I have been...
But I'm still getting stuck...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I need you to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't think of any other way at this point...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You're going to make me do all the work?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm doing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm just trying to use anything I have available to me in order to not disappoint my teammates...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Because I don't want to run...
Not like I did that time...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't want to...
But the past continues to haunt me and prevent me from moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It keeps telling me that I have no right to be in charge of expressing my team's resolve in the form of a song because I ran from music once already...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't get away from it...
No matter how hard I try...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've tried and tried, but I haven't been able to do what Ken and his team did...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The people who put on the event we're trying to surpass...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A member of their team became ill and ended up passing away... The event they put on and the songs they created for it were all meant to commemorate her life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What they sang, how they sang...
The atmosphere and energy they produced blew us all away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I've been tasked with writing songs that can help surpass that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I don't, our dream might end right here, and it could never end up coming true...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I need to hear your opinion, Dad! Tell me anything you can!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That explains why your song seemed to lack pride.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: The problem might be your understanding of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
That's the truth.
And there's nothing you can do to change the past.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That does not mean I think you lack what it takes.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I am saying that you still may have what it takes to go up against this Ken fellow and his team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, how can you say that...?
You've never met them before.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Even so, I seriously doubt you're going to lose to them.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You gave up some of the most important years of your life in order to train to become a classical musician.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That is how much time you spent living and breathing classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: From early in the morning to late at night, you spent hardly any time playing or sleeping.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I know.
It wasn't exactly the life you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It was the furthest thing from “normal” as you indicated that time.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But the fact remains that you spent an enormous amount of time studying classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No. Again. Until you get it right.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
We'll stop here for today.
It's time for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was able to play it all the way through just now...

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line:
But it didn't sound as pretty as I'd hoped...
So, um...

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Can I try it one last time?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Why do you keep dwelling on your decision to run?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Is this really it for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I disappointed you...
I completely dashed your hopes for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I did have high hopes for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: As I heard you play, I came to believe that you'd find the quintessential truth.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But you ended up choosing a different path in life. As a result, I felt something similar to disappointment...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But is that all you view that part of your life as?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Pain, suffering and disappointment?
Don't you remember anything else from those days?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I'm proud of the way you spent so much of your life studying classical music and I believe it's a beautiful achievement.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter how things ended.
There's nothing for you to be ashamed of.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
If anything, it's the opposite.
That time you spent...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No one can take that away from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It doesn't matter who these people you speak of are or how much time they spent on their music. You have what it takes to go up against them.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Because your past will allow you to do so.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I think I've overstayed my welcome...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I'll leave now.
But don't forget to clean your room.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd never be able to erase the past. That I'd always be the disappointment who ran away.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As it turns out, I have nothing to be ashamed of.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All I did was study music night and day.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And even if my joints ached or I had a high fever, I'd go over the music in my head.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not a day went by without me thinking about music. That much I know for certain. It consumes my life.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'd been studying how to play ever since I was very little...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And my past is now going to allow me to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To take on Ken, his team and their ironclad resolve.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Hey, did you guys hear?!
Vivid BAD SQUAD said they're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND during their next event!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard... But seriously?
I mean, I really doubt they will...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
No, they totally will!
I happened to hear Shinonome sing just now, and he put on an awesome show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the music player's all set.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiraishi.
Are the rest of you ready...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I can't wait to hear what kind of song it is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is still only the first one I've managed to complete.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But everything I've...we've experienced has gone into it. That much I can say for certain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, that means we've gotta listen carefully.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll start playing it now.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: My head... It's like I'm back in...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
When I saw RAD WEEKEND...
It's that feeling...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
When it grabbed a hold of my heart...
When I felt like singing my lungs out! That feeling...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm getting excited already. I've got a feeling that this song packs a serious punch...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I'm getting goosebumps just listening to it...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: This is insane, Toya! How did you make this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm also impressed...
You did an excellent job.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure it took you a lot of time and effort to come up with this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It did...
To be honest, I wasn't sure I'd ever be able to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Fortunately, I was able to in the end because I had something that kept me from running away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Something that kept you from running away?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My past. My old self who spent every waking minute studying classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No matter how hard things got, I kept on going. That made me stronger as a result.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Making this song showed me that nothing I did was a waste. It's all coming back to help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you did a great job, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know this song you wrote can help us surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Or rather...
We need this song in order to surpass it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is gonna be our secret weapon!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing your expressions... It makes me...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I guess I shouldn't be expecting to hear from him...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In any case, I'm done chasing after this dream.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Thanks for dropping by! Here, sit!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
So, how have things been since then?
You said that you guys aren't gonna give up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I came today to speak to you about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND during our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken agreed to help us with that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've been training ever since then, learned many new things and finally reached this point...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now's our chance to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like for you to listen to this song.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Huh...? Aoyagi, did you make this...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
In order to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I didn't mean for you to see that...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I dunno how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But your song reminded me of the day we made that promise...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please come see our next event, Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Because we will surpass RAD WEEKEND.
I guarantee it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're putting absolutely everything into it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because we were also curious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still don't know what's going to come of Soma and Tono.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think they understand how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All that's left is for us to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll use everything we've ever experienced as the fuel that propels us forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In order to break down that wall.
